names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 11 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. муч. Прокес и Мартинијан.“, where Св. муч. heads the pair and belongs to neither name, so each forename stands bare. The heading gives him no epithet; «the Jailer» in the English name is what the entry's first sentence says the two men were, and the corpus keeps such a clause in the display name. It is the same bare form `martinian-of-caesarea` holds off this same Prologue's heading for 13. фебруар ст. ст., „Преподобни Мартинијан.“, and that fold is deliberate and recorded in the run's findings.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.04.2026 (11. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Прокес и Мартинијан.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, an enumerated pair of two names, so two folders. **This is a new folder and not an upgrade of any Martinian the corpus holds, checked one by one.** `martinian-of-caesarea` is the ascetic the same Prologue keeps on 13 February, tempted by Zoe and dated to the early fifth century; `martinian-of-ephesus` belongs to the Seven Sleepers' company; `martinian-of-white-lake` and `martinian-of-zographou` are later monastics; `martinianus-of-areobindus` is the Greek 18 May; and `galaction-disciple-of-martinian` is named for yet another man. **None is a jailer, none is Roman, and none is a martyr of the apostles' own day.** **The whole of what this source gives the pair is five sentences**, and the life says so: jailers at the Roman prison holding Peter and Paul; baptised on hearing the apostles' words and seeing their wonders; they let the apostles out; the Lord met Peter on the road out of Rome and told him He was going there to be crucified again; the apostles turned back, were seized and killed, and these two were beheaded with them. **No year**: the entry gives none and none was inferred from the apostles' deaths. **No `locations`**, for the reason on the other folder's row. **The fold on the stored form is deliberate**: `martinian-of-caesarea` holds the same bare Мартинијан off this Prologue's own 13 February heading, and neither heading offers anything fuller — recorded in the run's findings before this was committed, and `corpus-gate.mjs` is expected to stop on it, this batch adding a new folder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
